How AI search fits

Buyers now ask AI assistants for recommendations. My research for Foundation Labs found that only about 16% of the citations behind n8n’s AI answers came from n8n’s own sites. So the work covers your pages and the outside sources AI relies on.

Questions people ask

How quickly will we see results?+

Leading signals move first: rankings, AI answer mentions and engagement on new pages. Pipeline follows as content builds up. I report on both, so you can see progress before the pipeline numbers arrive.

Who writes the content?+

I set the strategy and edit everything. Writing can come from me, your team, or a freelance team I brief and manage, as I did at RemotePass.

How do you measure success?+

Pipeline and qualified leads first. Then organic users, rankings for buying-stage searches, and how often AI assistants mention or cite you.

What’s the difference between SEO and AI search?+

AI search sits on top of SEO. Search engines still decide much of what AI reads, but AI also leans heavily on outside sources such as reviews, comparisons and communities. Good content work now covers both.

What proof should I ask a content consultant for?+

Named results with a timeframe, examples of the actual content, how they connected it to pipeline, and someone you can speak to. That’s the standard I hold my own work to.
